title: Trim names and give blank greetings a friendly fallback

steps.title: Keep surrounding spaces out of a greeting
paragraphs: Calling `greet(" Ada ")` currently produces `"Hello,  Ada !"` because the supplied name goes into the message unchanged. We will trim it to produce `"Hello, Ada!"`, then give blank names the fallback `"Hello, friend!"`.
places the supplied name between `"Hello, "` and `"!"`. We can clean up the name there, so callers still ask for a greeting with the same `greet(name)` call.

steps.title: Trim the name in a small helper
paragraphs: First, remove the unwanted spaces from the name itself. Add `displayName`, which calls `trim()`: `" Ada "` becomes `"Ada"`. Spaces between words stay in place, so `"Mary Ann"` stays `"Mary Ann"`.

Nothing calls the helper yet, so the greeting has not changed. Next, we will use its result in the message. An all-space name currently becomes an empty string; we will handle that case after connecting the helper.
